Delrean, also called Delrian, grows in conifer forests across Endor’s cold regions. Its leaves are easy to find and their unpleasant smell is central to their practical use.

Rubbed directly onto the skin, the leaves keep most insects at a distance of roughly ten feet. Their purpose is to repel insects rather than to treat a bite or sting already received.
